_doc: W238: what probe P1 (the SDDM greeter) types, and how success is known - the harness (luthen-observability:W127) replays it over RFB on the KubeVirt vnc subresource; the RFB client is the harness's choice, not this file's. Keys are X11 keysym names (RFC 6143 KeyEvent). Every wait is on a SERIAL record (catalog/guest-image.md (f)), never on pixels, so 'the greeter is up' and 'login succeeded' are guest facts. Credentials guard nothing: the VM is throwaway (oci/guest/customize.sh).

success.record: el.session then el.done (the session side sends both, only after a login)
success.and_policy: opa_gate serial admits the boot (policy/serial.rego, required[P1])
